text:
sophia: Quick check — planning a tiny sprint to clean up localization-specific dead links and orphan assets in the KB for JP/ES. I can run the link scan and open PRs for the top 15 hits. Who can pick up review + canary when ready?

mike: I can review Friday afternoon. timeline?

sophia: Target timeline: scan by EOD Wed, PRs Thurs, reviews Thurs-Fri, canary deploy next Tue. Want fast, low-risk patches (redirects, image rehosts, frontmatter owner fixes).

lina: Happy to help triage JP pages (I know the vendor path and S3 prefixes). Ping me the CSV export.

jules: Small ask — can we add an explicit "owners" frontmatter line to touched pages so we don't lose context later? I can spot-check those in review.

sophia: Yep — plan is: automated scan -> CSV -> split PRs by locale. Each PR will include: (1) link fix, (2) tiny frontmatter edit, (3) changelog note. I'll include a checklist. Also writing a tiny sed/python snippet to replace old gist shortlinks with canonical gist URLs where applicable.

mike: FYI the deploy bot will block merges if markdown-lint fails. @docs-bot can you run a quick lint on staging for the sample PR we opened yesterday?

docs-bot: lint job queued: https://ci.internal/reports/2345 — 1 failure found in /kb/ja/model-onboarding.md (missing alt text on image).

lina: I'll take the missing-alt fix in that file while I'm triaging JP pages.

sophia: Great — splitting work: I do the scan + shortlink cleanup script, Lina handles JP pages & quick asset fixes, Mike does review pass, Jules will merge and manage canary rollout if green.

jules: Sounds good. Also propose we add a CODEOWNERS note for /kb/ja and /kb/es folders so localization owners get notified on future PRs. We can do that as a follow-up PR.

sophia: Will do. I'll post the CSV and PR checklist here when PRs are ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:

mike: Thanks — ping when the CSV is live.

sophia: CSV exported: https://internal-csv/reports/locale_deadlinks_1766001234.csv (staging only). Assigning labels: locale:jp, locale:es, docs:quickfix.
